declare abstract class CompositeVMBase<VM extends ComponentVMBase> extends ComponentVMBase implements IOwningParentVM, IBatchable, ISelectableVmCollection<VM>, ObservableMembershipSource<VM> {
    #private;
    readonly supportsChildSelection = true;
    readonly owner: this;
    protected _children: VM[];
    constructor(opts: {
        name: string;
        /** Defaults to `""`. */
        hint?: string;
        hub: IMessageHub;
        dispatcher: IDispatcher;
        asyncSelection?: boolean;
        autoConstructOnAdd?: boolean;
        /** Defaults to `"insertion"` (spec/06 §5, ADR-0161). */
        destructOrder?: ChildOrder;
        onConstruct?: (() => void) | null;
        onDestruct?: (() => void) | null;
        currentSelector?: ((xs: Iterable<VM>) => VM | null) | null;
        onCurrentChanged?: ((vm: VM | null) => void) | null;
    });
    get type(): ViewModelType;
    get currentChild(): ComponentVMBase | null;
    get ownerParent(): IOwningParentVM | null;
    selectChild(vm: ComponentVMBase): void;
    deselectChild(vm: ComponentVMBase): void;
    containsChild(vm: ComponentVMBase): boolean;
    detachForTransfer(vm: ComponentVMBase): ParentTransfer;
    get collectionChanged(): Observable<CollectionChangedEvent>;
    get current(): VM | null;
    set current(value: VM | null);
    selectComponent(vm: VM): void;
    deselectComponent(vm: VM): void;
    /**
     * True only if {@link selectComponent} would succeed now: `vm` is an
     * admitted, constructed member, no disposal of this composite is pending,
     * and no membership transaction of this composite is uncommitted (spec/06
     * §3.1, ADR-0173).
     */
    canSelectComponent(vm: VM): boolean;
    get count(): number;
    [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<VM>;
    snapshot(): readonly VM[];
    subscribeMembership(callback: () => void): Subscription;
    at(index: number): VM;
    add(item: VM): void;
    insert(index: number, item: VM): void;
    remove(item: VM): boolean;
    removeAt(index: number): void;
    /** Replace the child at *index*. Emits a Remove followed by an Add (per spec). */
    setAt(index: number, value: VM): void;
    clear(): void;
    move(fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): void;
    batchUpdate(): BatchUpdateHandle;
    _exitBatch(): void;
    protected _emitCollectionChanged(event: CollectionChangedEvent): void;
    protected _maybeAutoConstruct(child: VM): void;
    /** Rejects an index outside the children; returns it with -0 as +0 (#769). */
    private _validateMoveIndex;
    protected _onConstruct(): void;
    protected _onDestruct(): void;
    dispose(): void;
    protected _onDispose(): void;
    protected _populateChildren(): void;
    protected _attachPopulation(children: Iterable<VM>): void;
    /**
     * The selection calls: the setter, `selectComponent`, `deselectComponent`
     * and the child `select`/`deselect` paths (spec/06 §3, §4.3, ADR-0173).
     * The call opens no membership transaction. It validates now and raises
     * as the synchronous setter does, also with `asyncSel`; the asynchronous
     * delivery validates again and drops silently when no longer valid.
     * `requireConstructed` (`selectComponent` and `selectChild`) makes the
     * delivery also drop a child that is no longer Constructed (#1220, #1229).
     */
    protected _setCurrent(value: VM | null, asyncSel: boolean, requireConstructed?: boolean): void;
}

/**
 * CompositeVM<VM> — non-modeled composite viewmodel.
 *
 * See spec/06-composite-vm.md.
 */

declare const optionHub$1: unique symbol;
declare const optionDispatcher$1: unique symbol;
declare class CompositeVM<VM extends ComponentVMBase> extends CompositeVMBase<VM> {
    #private;
    constructor(opts: {
        name: string;
        /** Defaults to `""`. */
        hint?: string;
        hub: IMessageHub;
        dispatcher: IDispatcher;
        asyncSelection?: boolean;
        autoConstructOnAdd?: boolean;
        destructOrder?: ChildOrder;
        childrenFactory?: (() => Iterable<VM>) | null;
        onConstruct?: (() => void) | null;
        onDestruct?: (() => void) | null;
        currentSelector?: ((xs: Iterable<VM>) => VM | null) | null;
        onCurrentChanged?: ((vm: VM | null) => void) | null;
    });
    protected _populateChildren(): void;
    static builder<VM extends ComponentVMBase>(): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    /**
     * Constructs a {@link CompositeVM} from an options object in a single call —
     * an additive alternative to the fluent {@link CompositeVMBuilder}. Delegates
     * to that builder, so the required-field validation
     * ({@link BuilderValidationError} on a missing name/services/children) and the
     * resulting VM are identical to the fluent path.
     */
    static create<VM extends ComponentVMBase>(options: CompositeVMOptions<VM>): CompositeVM<VM>;
}
/**
 * Options for the additive {@link CompositeVM.create} construction form
 * (ADR-0055 / VMX-020). A one-call alternative to the fluent
 * {@link CompositeVMBuilder}.
 */
interface CompositeVMOptions<VM extends ComponentVMBase> {
    /** Required VM name. */
    name: string;
    /** Required message hub. */
    hub: IMessageHub;
    /** Required dispatcher. */
    dispatcher: IDispatcher;
    /** Required children factory (invoked lazily on construct; `() => []` for empty). */
    children: () => Iterable<VM>;
    /** Optional hint (default: ""). */
    hint?: string;
    /** Optional async-selection flag (default: false). */
    asyncSelection?: boolean;
    /** Optional auto-construct-on-add flag (default: false). */
    autoConstructOnAdd?: boolean;
    /** Optional child destruct and dispose order (default: `"insertion"`; ADR-0161). */
    destructOrder?: ChildOrder;
    /** Optional initial-current selector (see ADR-0042). */
    current?: (xs: Iterable<VM>) => VM | null;
    /** Optional current-changed callback (see ADR-0042). */
    onCurrentChanged?: (vm: VM | null) => void;
    /** Optional OnConstruct lifecycle callback. */
    onConstruct?: () => void;
    /** Optional OnDestruct lifecycle callback. */
    onDestruct?: () => void;
}
declare class CompositeVMBuilder<VM extends ComponentVMBase> {
    #private;
    constructor(from?: CompositeVMBuilder<VM>);
    name(value: string): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    hint(value: string): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    services(hub: IMessageHub, dispatcher: IDispatcher): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    [optionHub$1](hub: IMessageHub): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    [optionDispatcher$1](dispatcher: IDispatcher): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    asyncSelection(value: boolean): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    autoConstructOnAdd(value: boolean): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    /**
     * Sets the order in which the composite destructs and disposes its children
     * (spec/06 §5, ADR-0161). `"insertion"` (the default) walks them first child
     * first; `"reverse"` walks them last child first. Construct order is
     * unchanged, and every child is still disposed before the composite
     * (LIFE-013).
     */
    destructOrder(order: ChildOrder): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    children(factory: () => Iterable<VM>): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    onConstruct(cb: () => void): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    onDestruct(cb: () => void): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    /**
     * Sets an optional selector that picks the initial `current` child during
     * `construct()`, after every child has reached `Constructed` but before the
     * composite itself reaches `Constructed`. If the selector returns `null` or
     * a value not in the composite, `current` is left unchanged and no
     * `PropertyChangedMessage("current")` is published. See ADR-0042 and
     * spec/06 §3.2.
     */
    current(selector: (xs: Iterable<VM>) => VM | null): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    /**
     * Sets an optional callback invoked synchronously after every `current`
     * change, immediately after the hub `PropertyChangedMessage("current")` is
     * published. Receives the new `current` value (or `null` on deselection).
     * Fires once for the initial assignment driven by `current(selector)`.
     * See ADR-0042 and spec/06 §3.2.
     */
    onCurrentChanged(callback: (vm: VM | null) => void): CompositeVMBuilder<VM>;
    build(): CompositeVM<VM>;
}

    component2(f: () => VM2): AggregateVM3Builder<VM1, VM2, VM3>;
    component3(f: () => VM3): AggregateVM3Builder<VM1, VM2, VM3>;
    build(): AggregateVM3<VM1, VM2, VM3>;
}

declare function walk(root: ComponentVMBase): Iterable<ComponentVMBase>;

/** Options for constructing a HierarchicalVM node. */
interface HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM> {
    model: TModel;
    childrenFactory: (parent: TVM) => Iterable<TVM>;
    hub?: IMessageHub;
    dispatcher?: IDispatcher;
    name?: string;
    hint?: string;
    /** When true, this node materializes and constructs its children at construct() time (depth-first, per node: spec/18 §4). */
    eagerChildren?: boolean;
}
/** Missing-parent retention policy for {@link HierarchicalVM.attachMany}. */
declare enum MissingParentPolicy {
    Park = "park",
    Reject = "reject"
}
/** Typed reason why one batch item was not attached. */
declare enum BatchAttachRejectionReason {
    DuplicateExistingKey = "duplicate_existing_key",
    DuplicateBatchKey = "duplicate_batch_key",
    AlreadyAttached = "already_attached",
    MissingParent = "missing_parent",
    Cycle = "cycle",
    SelectorFailed = "selector_failed",
    AttachmentFailed = "attachment_failed"
}
interface BatchAttachOptions<TVM, TKey> {
    keyOf: (item: TVM) => TKey;
    /** A null parent key attaches the item directly beneath the structural root. */
    parentKeyOf: (item: TVM) => TKey | null;
    onMissingParent?: MissingParentPolicy;
}
interface BatchAttachRejection<TVM> {
    item: TVM;
    reason: BatchAttachRejectionReason;
    detail?: string;
}
interface BatchAttachResult<TVM> {
    added: readonly TVM[];
    duplicates: readonly TVM[];
    orphans: readonly TVM[];
    rejections: readonly BatchAttachRejection<TVM>[];
}
/**
 * Abstract recursive tree ViewModel. Concrete subclasses must satisfy the
 * recursive generic constraint: `class MyNode extends HierarchicalVM<MyModel, MyNode>`.
 *
 * @typeParam TModel - Domain model type for each node.
 * @typeParam TVM - Concrete subclass type (recursive constraint per ADR-0028 §3.2).
 */
declare abstract class HierarchicalVM<TModel, TVM extends HierarchicalVM<TModel, TVM>> extends ComponentVMBase {
    #private;
    /** Builds a node that publishes its messages on `opts.hub`. */
    constructor(opts: HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM> & {
        hub: IMessageHub;
        dispatcher: IDispatcher;
    });
    /**
     * @deprecated Pass `hub` and `dispatcher`, or build the node with
     * `HierarchicalVMBuilder`. Without them the node publishes to a private hub
     * that no application observer sees. `@thekaveh/vmx` 4.0 requires both
     * (ADR-0009).
     */
    constructor(opts: HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM>);
    get type(): ViewModelType;
    /** The domain model carried by this tree node. */
    get model(): TModel;
    /** The parent node; null when this node is the root. */
    get parent(): TVM | null;
    /** true when parent is null. */
    get isRoot(): boolean;
    /** Distance from the root. Root is 0; child of root is 1; etc. */
    get depth(): number;
    /**
     * true when this node has no children.
     * Note: accessing this property materializes children if not yet done.
     */
    get isLeaf(): boolean;
    /** true when this is the first child in its parent's children list. */
    get isFirst(): boolean;
    /** true when this is the last child in its parent's children list. */
    get isLast(): boolean;
    /** The ordered list of child nodes (lazily materialized by default). */
    get children(): readonly TVM[];
    /**
     * Materialized, cached path from the root to this node (inclusive).
     * Invalidated when parent changes.
     */
    get path(): readonly TVM[];
    [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<TVM>;
    protected _onConstruct(): void;
    /**
     * Adds child to this node's children list, sets its parent, and publishes
     * a TreeStructureChangedMessage(Added) on the hub.
     */
    addChild(child: TVM): void;
    /**
     * Removes child from this node's children list and publishes
     * a TreeStructureChangedMessage(Removed) on the hub.
     */
    removeChild(child: TVM): void;
    /**
     * Moves child from its current parent to this node and publishes
     * a TreeStructureChangedMessage(Reparented) on the hub.
     */
    reparentChild(child: TVM): void;
    /** Number of missing-parent items retained on this node's structural root. */
    get parkedAttachCount(): number;
    /**
     * Attach an out-of-order, consumer-keyed batch beneath the structural root.
     * Ordinary ingestion anomalies are returned as typed rejections and never
     * replace an already-materialized node with the same key.
     */
    attachMany<TKey>(items: Iterable<TVM>, options: BatchAttachOptions<TVM, TKey>): BatchAttachResult<TVM>;
    /**
     * Drops this node's materialized child cache. The next `children` access
     * invokes `childrenFactory` again. Invalidating an unmaterialized node is a
     * no-op.
     */
    invalidateChildren(): void;
    /** Drops cached children for this node and all materialized descendants. */
    invalidateSubtree(): void;
    protected _onDispose(): void;
}
/**
 * Context object passed to a {@link HierarchicalVMBuilder}'s `vmFactory`
 * callable. Carries the settled, validated construction options so the
 * factory can instantiate the concrete TVM subclass.
 *
 * It is {@link HierarchicalVMOptions} with `hub` and `dispatcher` required:
 * `build()` always supplies both, so `super(context)` binds the constructor
 * overload with services rather than the deprecated one.
 */
type HierarchicalVMConstructionContext<TModel, TVM> = HierarchicalVMOptions<TModel, TVM> & {
    hub: IMessageHub;
    dispatcher: IDispatcher;
};
/**
 * Immutable fluent builder for {@link HierarchicalVM}.
 *
 * Required setters: {@link model}, {@link childrenFactory}, {@link services},
 * {@link vmFactory}.
 *
 * Optional setters: {@link name}, {@link hint}, {@link eagerChildren}.
 *
 * Withers: {@link withDefaultServices} — explicit opt-in to default
 * `MessageHub` + `RxDispatcher.immediate()` wiring (mirrors Python's
 * `with_default_services()`; ADR-0035 §2 H2).
 *
 * `vmFactory` is required because TS classes erase their generic-type
 * identity at runtime: the builder cannot itself instantiate a concrete TVM
 * subclass. Consumers supply a factory `(ctx) => new MyNode(ctx)` instead.
 *
 * Each setter returns a NEW builder instance (BLD-001). `build()` validates
 * each required field and throws {@link BuilderValidationError} on the first
 * missing one (BLD-002).
 */
declare class HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM extends HierarchicalVM<TModel, TVM>> {
    #private;
    constructor(from?: HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>);
    /** Set the required domain model carried by the node. */
    model(value: TModel): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /** Set the required children factory `(parent) => Iterable<TVM>`. */
    childrenFactory(fn: (parent: TVM) => Iterable<TVM>): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /** Set the required message hub + dispatcher pair. */
    services(hub: IMessageHub, dispatcher: IDispatcher): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /** Set the optional `name` (default: concrete class name). */
    name(value: string): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /** Set the optional `hint` (default: empty string). */
    hint(value: string): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /**
     * When `true`, this node materializes and constructs its children at
     * construct() time (depth-first). The option applies per node (spec/18 §4).
     * Default: `false`.
     */
    eagerChildren(value: boolean): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /**
     * Set the required factory that instantiates the concrete TVM subclass.
     *
     * TS erases generic-type identity at runtime, so the builder cannot
     * instantiate a concrete TVM directly — consumers wire a factory:
     *
     * ```ts
     * .vmFactory((ctx) => new MyNode(ctx))
     * ```
     */
    vmFactory(fn: (ctx: HierarchicalVMConstructionContext<TModel, TVM>) => TVM): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /**
     * Chainable Wither that wires a fresh {@link MessageHub} +
     * {@link RxDispatcher.immediate} pair in a single call. Mirrors Python's
     * `with_default_services()` per ADR-0035 §2 H2 — makes the implicit-default
     * behavior of {@link HierarchicalVM}'s constructor visible at the call site.
     */
    withDefaultServices(): HierarchicalVMBuilder<TModel, TVM>;
    /**
     * Validate required fields and construct the concrete TVM by invoking
     * `vmFactory` with the settled options.
     *
     * @throws {BuilderValidationError} If `model`, `childrenFactory`,
     *   `services`, or `vmFactory` is not set.
     */
    build(): TVM;
}

/**
 * TreeSelection<TVM> — opt-in "one current node per tree" helper.
 *
 * See spec/18-hierarchical-vm.md §10, ADR-0164 and HIER-033..HIER-040.
 */

/**
 * Tracks one current node of the tree below a {@link HierarchicalVM} root
 * (spec/18 §10). A tree node cannot be the `current` item of a container, so
 * a consumer that needs one current node per tree composes this helper on the
 * root instead.
 *
 * A node is selectable when walking its `parent` links reaches the root (the
 * root itself qualifies) and no node on that path is `Disposed`. The checks
 * read only `parent` and `status`, so they never invoke a children factory.
 *
 * While a node is current, the helper subscribes to the hub of every node on
 * the path from that node to the root (one subscription per distinct hub).
 * On any message whose sender is a path node, it repeats the check: it clears
 * the selection when the node has left the tree, and it watches the new path
 * after a move inside the tree.
 *
 * The helper publishes nothing to a hub and never changes, materializes or
 * disposes a node. The owning VM forwards {@link currentChanged} to its own
 * property notification (spec/14 rule 6). Like the tree, the helper is used
 * from one thread and takes no locks.
 *
 * @typeParam TVM - The concrete tree node type.
 */
declare class TreeSelection<TVM extends HierarchicalVM<unknown, TVM>> {
    #private;
    /**
     * Creates a selection over the tree below `root`. The helper does not take
     * ownership of `root`.
     *
     * @throws {TypeError} If `root` is null or undefined.
     */
    constructor(root: TVM);
    /** The current node, or null when nothing is selected. */
    get current(): TVM | null;
    /**
     * Emits the new `current`, or null, once for every effective change. Hot:
     * a new subscriber receives no replayed value. Completes on `dispose()`.
     */
    get currentChanged(): Observable<TVM | null>;
    /**
     * True when this helper is not disposed, `node` reaches the root through its
     * `parent` links, and no node on that path is `Disposed`.
     */
    canSelect(node: TVM | null | undefined): boolean;
    /**
     * Makes `node` current. Selecting the current node again does nothing, and
     * so does any call after `dispose()`.
     *
     * @throws {TypeError} If `node` is null or undefined.
     * @throws {Error} If {@link canSelect} rejects `node`; `current` keeps its
     *   value and nothing is emitted.
     */
    select(node: TVM): void;
    /** Sets `current` to null. Does nothing when it is already null or after `dispose()`. */
    clear(): void;
    /**
     * Releases the hub subscriptions, sets `current` to null without emitting,
     * and completes {@link currentChanged}. Every step runs; the first failure
     * is rethrown. Idempotent. Never disposes or detaches a node.
     */
    dispose(): void;
}

/**
 * NullDialogService — null-object implementation of {@link IDialogService}.
 *
 * All methods return the safest default:
 * - `pickFileToOpen` / `pickFileToSave` → `null` (treat as cancel)
 * - `confirm` → `false` (avoids triggering destructive operations)
 * - `notify` → no-op
 *
 * Stateless — safe to share via {@link NullDialogService.INSTANCE}.
 * See spec/19-dialogs.md §4 and ADR-0017.
 */

declare class NullDialogService implements IModalDialogService {
    /** Shared singleton instance (the service holds no state). */
    static readonly INSTANCE: NullDialogService;
    private constructor();
    pickFileToOpen(_filter?: FileFilter | null, _title?: string | null): Promise<string | null>;
    pickFileToSave(_filter?: FileFilter | null, _title?: string | null, _suggestedName?: string | null): Promise<string | null>;
    confirm(_message: string, _title?: string | null): Promise<boolean>;
    notify(_message: string, _title?: string | null, _severity?: NotificationSeverity): Promise<void>;
    present<T>(modalVm: ModalVM<T>): Promise<T>;
}

/**
 * FormRevertedMessage — emitted when a FormVM reverts its Model to Snapshot.
 *
 * See spec/20-form-vm.md §8 — Hub messages.
 */

declare class FormRevertedMessage implements IMessage {
    readonly sender: object;
    readonly senderName: string;
    constructor(sender: object, senderName: string);
}

interface IExpandable {
    readonly isExpanded: boolean;
    canExpand(): boolean;
    expand(): void;
}
interface ICollapsible {
    canCollapse(): boolean;
    collapse(): void;
}
interface IExpansionTogglable {
    canToggleExpansion(): boolean;
    toggleExpansion(): void;
}

/**
 * ExpandableState — composition-friendly helper for expand/collapse.
 *
 * See spec/05-component-vm.md §8 (`IExpandable` integration), ADR-0015 and
 * ADR-0159 (expansion commands).
 */

declare class ExpandableState implements IExpandable, ICollapsible, IExpansionTogglable {
    #private;
    constructor(initiallyExpanded?: boolean);
    get isExpanded(): boolean;
    get isExpandedChanged(): Observable<boolean>;
    /**
     * Runs `expand()` when `canExpand()` is true. Owned by this helper:
     * `dispose()` disposes it, and callers must not.
     */
    get expandCommand(): RelayCommand;
    /**
     * Runs `collapse()` when `canCollapse()` is true. Owned by this helper:
     * `dispose()` disposes it, and callers must not.
     */
    get collapseCommand(): RelayCommand;
    /**
     * Runs `toggleExpansion()` when `canToggleExpansion()` is true. Owned by
     * this helper: `dispose()` disposes it, and callers must not.
     */
    get toggleExpansionCommand(): RelayCommand;
    canExpand(): boolean;
    expand(): void;
    canCollapse(): boolean;
    collapse(): void;
    canToggleExpansion(): boolean;
    toggleExpansion(): void;
    /**
     * Disposes the commands that were read, then completes `isExpandedChanged`.
     * Every step runs; the first failure is rethrown. Idempotent: subsequent
     * calls are a no-op.
     */
    dispose(): void;
}

interface ISearchable {
    searchTerm: string;
    canSearch(): boolean;
    search(): void;
}

/**
 * SearchableState — debounced filter helper implementing ISearchable.
 *
 * See spec/06-composite-vm.md §Search / filter and ADR-0014.
 */

interface SearchableStateOptions<T> {
    items: () => Iterable<T>;
    predicate: (item: T, term: string) => boolean;
    debounceMs?: number;
    scheduler?: SchedulerLike;
    /** Optional invalidation signal; payloads are ignored. */
    sourceChanges?: Observable<unknown>;
}
declare class SearchableState<T> implements ISearchable {
    #private;
    constructor(opts: SearchableStateOptions<T>);
    get searchTerm(): string;
    set searchTerm(value: string);
    /**
     * The current filtered view, recomputed on each debounced term change,
     * explicit {@link search} call, and optional `sourceChanges` pulse. Source
     * completion or failure stops automatic refresh without terminating this
     * observable.
     */
    get filtered(): Observable<readonly T[]>;
    canSearch(): boolean;
    search(): void;
    /** Idempotent: subsequent calls are a no-op. */
    dispose(): void;
}

/**
 * DerivedProperty — value derived from N source observables.
 *
 * See spec/15-derived-properties.md and ADR-0011.
 */

declare class DerivedProperty<TValue> {
    #private;
    constructor(derivedStream: Observable<TValue>, canSet?: ((v: TValue) => boolean) | null, setAction?: ((v: TValue) => void) | null);
    get value(): TValue;
    get valueChanged(): Observable<TValue>;
    canSet(value: TValue): boolean;
    setValue(value: TValue): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
interface DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue> {
    canSet?: (value: TValue) => boolean;
    setAction?: (value: TValue) => void;
}
/** Build a DerivedProperty from one typed source (ADR-0035 §2 DP2). */
declare function fromOne<T1, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, transform: (v1: T1) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
/** Build a DerivedProperty from two typed sources (ADR-0035 §2 DP2). */
declare function fromTwo<T1, T2, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
/** Build a DerivedProperty from three typed sources (ADR-0035 §2 DP2). */
declare function fromThree<T1, T2, T3, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, s3: Observable<T3>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2, v3: T3) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
/** Build a DerivedProperty from four typed sources (ADR-0035 §2 DP2). */
declare function fromFour<T1, T2, T3, T4, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, s3: Observable<T3>, s4: Observable<T4>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2, v3: T3, v4: T4) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
/** Build a DerivedProperty from five typed sources (ADR-0035 §2 DP2). */
declare function fromFive<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, TValue>(s1: Observable<T1>, s2: Observable<T2>, s3: Observable<T3>, s4: Observable<T4>, s5: Observable<T5>, transform: (v1: T1, v2: T2, v3: T3, v4: T4, v5: T5) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
/**
 * Build a DerivedProperty from N source observables.
 * `fromMany` is the parity alias (Python `from_many`).
 */
declare function fromSources<TValue>(sources: Observable<unknown>[], transform: (...values: unknown[]) => TValue, opts?: DerivedFromSourcesOptions<TValue>): DerivedProperty<TValue>;
/** Parity alias of {@link fromSources} (Python `from_many`, C# `FromMany`). */
declare const fromMany: typeof fromSources;

/**

interface ILocalizer {
    localize(key: string, args?: readonly unknown[]): string;
}

/**

 */

declare class NullLocalizer implements ILocalizer {
    static readonly INSTANCE: NullLocalizer;
    private constructor();
    localize(key: string, _args?: readonly unknown[]): string;
}

// ==== messageHub.d.ts ====
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

/**
 * Core message interfaces for the VMx hub.
 *
 * See spec/03-messages.md §IMessage shape.
 */
/**
 * Base message — every hub message implements this.
 *
 * `sender` is the runtime sender instance, exposed uniformly across all
 * flavors as the canonical field (ADR-0006 / ADR-0054). It is typed `unknown`
 * here because the untyped base cannot name a concrete sender type; the typed
 * {@link ITypedMessage} narrows it to `TSender`.
 */
interface IMessage {
    readonly senderName: string;
    readonly sender: unknown;
}
/** Typed message — narrows {@link IMessage.sender} to a strongly-typed reference. */
interface ITypedMessage<TSender> extends IMessage {
    readonly sender: TSender;
}

/**
 * MessageHub — hot Subject-backed pub/sub stream for IMessage events.
 *
 * See spec/03-messages.md for the hub contract (HUB-001..HUB-013).
 *
 * HUB-007: a subscriber throwing in its next handler must not break other
 * subscribers or stop the hub. rxjs v7 isolates observer failures and reports
 * them through config.onUnhandledError asynchronously; tests that intentionally
 * throw opt into scoped suppression in tests/setup.ts.
 */

interface IMessageHub {
    readonly messages: Observable<IMessage>;
    send(message: IMessage): void;
}
/** Additive capability for hubs that support lossless message transactions. */
interface ITransactionalMessageHub extends IMessageHub {
    batch(transaction: () => void): void;
}
interface MessageHubOptions {
    /**
     * Enable the bounded development cycle diagnostic. Node development/test
     * processes enable it automatically; browser hosts opt in because the web
     * platform has no standard development-mode flag.
     */
    readonly developmentDiagnostics?: boolean;
}
declare class MessageHub implements ITransactionalMessageHub {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: MessageHubOptions);
    get messages(): Observable<IMessage>;
    send(message: IMessage): void;
    batch(transaction: () => void): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

export { type IMessage as I, MessageHub as M, type IMessageHub as a, type ITransactionalMessageHub as b, type ITypedMessage as c, type MessageHubOptions as d };

// ==== notifications.d.ts ====
import { Observable, SchedulerLike } from 'rxjs';
import { R as RelayCommand } from './relayCommand.js';

/**
 * Notification primitives. See spec/16-notifications.md.
 */
declare enum NotificationType {
    Error = "Error",
    Notification = "Notification",
    Confirmation = "Confirmation"
}
declare enum NotificationReaction {
    Pending = "Pending",
    Approve = "Approve",
    Reject = "Reject"
}
declare class Notification {
    readonly type: NotificationType;
    readonly message: string;
    constructor(type: NotificationType, message: string);
}

/**
 * NotificationHub — async notification / confirmation hub.
 *
 * See spec/16-notifications.md and ADR-0013.
 */

interface INotificationHub {
    readonly pending: Observable<readonly Notification[]>;
    post(notification: Notification): Promise<NotificationReaction>;
    resolve(notification: Notification, reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
}
declare class NotificationHub implements INotificationHub {
    #private;
    get pending(): Observable<readonly Notification[]>;
    post(notification: Notification): Promise<NotificationReaction>;
    resolve(notification: Notification, reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
    /**
     * Resolve in-flight waiters with `Pending` and complete `pending`.
     * Idempotent (NOTIF-017). Mirrors the C# hub's shutdown semantics:
     * subsequent `post` calls resolve immediately with `Pending` without
     * enqueueing, and subsequent `resolve` calls are no-ops.
     */
    dispose(): void;
}

/**
 * NullNotificationHub — null-object variant per ADR-0017.
 */

declare class NullNotificationHub implements INotificationHub {
    static readonly INSTANCE: NullNotificationHub;
    private constructor();
    readonly pending: Observable<readonly Notification[]>;
    post(_notification: Notification): Promise<NotificationReaction>;
    resolve(_notification: Notification, _reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
}

declare function makeConfirm(hub: INotificationHub, prompt: string): () => Promise<boolean>;

/**
 * NotificationVM — render-side ViewModel for a Notification.
 *
 * See spec/16-notifications.md §NotificationVM and ADR-0031.
 */

/**
 * Render-side ViewModel for a {@link Notification}.
 *
 * Exposes UI-bindable state:
 * - `notification` — the consumed datum
 * - `lifespanMs` — configured lifespan in milliseconds (default 60 000)
 * - `remainingMs` — decays toward 0 via the injected scheduler
 * - `opacity` — derived `remainingMs / lifespanMs`, range [0.0, 1.0]
 * - `isResolved` — `true` once resolved
 * - `dismissCommand` — resolves with Approve and cancels the timer
 * - `propertyChanged` — INPC-style change-notification stream (VMX-135)
 *
 * Auto-dismiss: when `remainingMs` reaches 0, the VM resolves the notification
 * with {@link NotificationReaction.Approve}.
 * Use {@link ConfirmationVM} for explicit user action instead.
 *
 * Change-notification (VMX-135): `propertyChanged` emits property names so a
 * binding view can repaint. `isResolved` always emits on resolution; when a
 * `tickIntervalMs` is supplied, `remainingMs`/`opacity` emit periodically while
 * the notification fades. Without a tick interval the two time-varying
 * properties stay poll-only (no recurring scheduler work), preserving the prior
 * behaviour.
 */
declare class NotificationVM {
    #private;
    readonly dismissCommand: RelayCommand;
    constructor(notification: Notification, hub: INotificationHub, scheduler: SchedulerLike, lifespanMs?: number, tickIntervalMs?: number);
    /** The notification datum consumed by this VM. */
    get notification(): Notification;
    /**
     * INPC-style change-notification stream (VMX-135): emits the name of each
     * property whose value changed (`isResolved`, and — when a tick interval is
     * configured — `remainingMs`/`opacity` as the notification fades).
     */
    get propertyChanged(): Observable<string>;
    /** Configured lifespan in milliseconds (default 60 000 ms). */
    get lifespanMs(): number;
    /** Remaining time in milliseconds. Decays toward 0. */
    get remainingMs(): number;
    /**
     * Opacity derived as `remainingMs / lifespanMs`. Range [0.0, 1.0].
     * Linear decay from 1.0 to 0.0 over `lifespanMs`.
     */
    get opacity(): number;
    /** `true` once the notification has been resolved (manually or by timer). */
    get isResolved(): boolean;
    /** Disposes resources: cancels the timer, pending subscription, and command. */
    dispose(): void;
    /**
     * Whether this VM arms the lifespan expiry timer at construction.
     * Default: `true` (auto-dismiss on expiry). `ConfirmationVM` overrides this
     * to `false` because it never auto-resolves — avoiding a no-op timer
     * (VMX-092). Called from the constructor; overrides must not read
     * subclass-initialized state.
     */
    protected armsExpiryTimer(): boolean;
    /**
     * Called when the lifespan timer fires.
     * Default: auto-dismiss with Approve.
     * `ConfirmationVM` overrides to suppress auto-dismiss.
     */
    protected onExpire(): void;
    /** Resolves with Approve and cancels the timer. Idempotent. */
    protected dismiss(): void;
    /** Resolves with the given reaction and cancels the timer. Idempotent. */
    protected resolveWith(reaction: NotificationReaction): void;
}

/**
 * ConfirmationVM — render-side ViewModel for a confirmation Notification.
 *
 * See spec/16-notifications.md §ConfirmationVM and ADR-0031.
 */

/**
 * Render-side ViewModel for a confirmation {@link Notification}.
 *
 * Extends {@link NotificationVM} with explicit {@link approveCommand} and
 * {@link rejectCommand}. Default lifespan is 300 000 ms (300 seconds).
 *
 * Unlike {@link NotificationVM}, ConfirmationVM does **not** auto-resolve on
 * lifespan expiry — timeout means "user did not decide".
 */
declare class ConfirmationVM extends NotificationVM {
    readonly approveCommand: RelayCommand;
    readonly rejectCommand: RelayCommand;
    constructor(notification: Notification, hub: INotificationHub, scheduler: SchedulerLike, lifespanMs?: number, tickIntervalMs?: number);
    /**
     * VMX-092: ConfirmationVM never auto-resolves, so it declines to arm the
     * lifespan expiry timer at all — there is no work for it to do on fire.
     * (Observable behavior is unchanged: timeout still means "user did not
     * decide" and the notification remains pending.)
     */
    protected armsExpiryTimer(): boolean;
    /**
     * ConfirmationVM does NOT auto-resolve on lifespan expiry.
     * Timeout means "user did not decide"; the notification remains pending.
     * Retained as a defensive no-op in case a subclass re-arms the timer.
     */
    protected onExpire(): void;
    /**
     * Delegates to base dispose, then disposes the commands. The base marks the
     * VM disposed first, so an observer that runs while a command is disposed
     * cannot resolve the hub (#753).
     */
    dispose(): void;
}

export { ConfirmationVM, type INotificationHub, Notification, NotificationHub, NotificationReaction, NotificationType, NotificationVM, NullNotificationHub, makeConfirm };

// ==== relayCommand.d.ts ====
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

/**
 * ICommand interfaces for the VMx command contract.
 *
 * See spec/04-commands.md.
 */

interface ICommand {
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    readonly canExecuteChanged: Observable<void>;
}
interface ICommandOf<T> {
    canExecute(parameter: T): boolean;
    execute(parameter: T): void;
    readonly canExecuteChanged: Observable<void>;
}
/**
 * An ICommand whose work is asynchronous and cancellable.
 *
 * See spec/04-commands.md §10 (async command cancellation), ADR-0056.
 *
 * `executeAsync` flows an `AbortSignal` into the task; `cancel()` aborts the
 * in-flight execution via an internal `AbortController`. Cancellation is
 * non-throwing to the caller by default — the awaited `executeAsync` resolves
 * on cancel rather than rejecting — mirroring the dialog cancellation contract
 * (spec/19-dialogs.md §7, DIA-007). While an execution is in flight `canExecute`
 * returns `false`, so the command cannot double-run.
 */
interface IAsyncCommand extends ICommand {
    /** True while an execution is in flight; false when idle. */
    readonly isExecuting: boolean;
    /** Runs the async task, optionally linked to an external `AbortSignal`. */
    executeAsync(externalSignal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;
    /** Requests cancellation of the in-flight execution; a no-op when idle. */
    cancel(): void;
}

declare class RelayCommand implements ICommand {
    #private;
    constructor(task: (() => void) | null, predicate: (() => boolean) | null, triggers: Observable<unknown>[]);
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    /** Emit one re-evaluation notification without invoking user delegates. */
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    /** Idempotent: subsequent calls are a no-op. */
    dispose(): void;
    static builder(): RelayCommandBuilder;
}
declare class RelayCommandBuilder {
    #private;
    constructor(task: (() => void) | null, predicate: (() => boolean) | null, triggers: readonly Observable<unknown>[]);
    task(fn: () => void): RelayCommandBuilder;
    predicate(fn: () => boolean): RelayCommandBuilder;
    triggers(obs: Observable<unknown>): RelayCommandBuilder;
    build(): RelayCommand;
}
declare class RelayCommandOf<T> implements ICommandOf<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(task: ((p: T) => void) | null, predicate: ((p: T) => boolean) | null, triggers: Observable<unknown>[]);
    canExecute(parameter: T): boolean;
    execute(parameter: T): void;
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    /** Emit one re-evaluation notification without invoking user delegates. */
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    /** Idempotent: subsequent calls are a no-op. */
    dispose(): void;
    static builder<T>(): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
}
declare class RelayCommandOfBuilder<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(task: ((p: T) => void) | null, predicate: ((p: T) => boolean) | null, triggers: readonly Observable<unknown>[]);
    task(fn: (p: T) => void): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
    predicate(fn: (p: T) => boolean): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
    triggers(obs: Observable<unknown>): RelayCommandOfBuilder<T>;
    build(): RelayCommandOf<T>;
}

export { type ICommand as I, RelayCommand as R, type IAsyncCommand as a, type ICommandOf as b, RelayCommandBuilder as c, RelayCommandOf as d, RelayCommandOfBuilder as e };

// ==== testing.d.ts ====
import { Observable, SchedulerLike } from 'rxjs';
import { b as ITransactionalMessageHub, d as MessageHubOptions, I as IMessage, a as IMessageHub } from './messageHub.js';
import { I as IDispatcher, a as CollectionMutationAction, C as CollectionChangedMessage, P as PropertyChangedMessage, O as ObservableList, F as FormVM, c as FormVMOptions } from './formVm.js';
import { a as IAsyncCommand, I as ICommand, b as ICommandOf } from './relayCommand.js';

/** A real MessageHub that also retains messages in their delivered order. */
declare class RecordingMessageHub implements ITransactionalMessageHub {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: MessageHubOptions);
    get messages(): Observable<IMessage>;
    /** A copy of the messages delivered so far. */
    get records(): readonly IMessage[];
    send(message: IMessage): void;
    batch(transaction: () => void): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

/** Dispatcher whose foreground and background queues advance only on demand. */
declare class ManualDispatcher implements IDispatcher {
    #private;
    readonly foreground: SchedulerLike;
    readonly background: SchedulerLike;
    flushForeground(): void;
    flushBackground(): void;
    flushAll(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
interface TestServices {
    readonly hub: RecordingMessageHub;
    readonly dispatcher: IDispatcher;
    dispose(): void;
}
/** Create the standard hermetic VMx service pair for a unit test. */
declare function createTestServices(): TestServices;

interface PropertyChangeFilter<TSender> {
    readonly sender?: TSender;
    readonly propertyName?: string;
}
/** Records semantic PropertyChanged messages and owns its hub subscription. */
declare class PropertyChangeRecorder<TSender = unknown> {
    #private;
    constructor(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: PropertyChangeFilter<TSender>);
    get records(): readonly PropertyChangedMessage<TSender>[];
    get propertyNames(): readonly string[];
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function recordPropertyChanges<TSender = unknown>(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: PropertyChangeFilter<TSender>): PropertyChangeRecorder<TSender>;
interface CollectionChangeFilter {
    readonly sender?: object;
    readonly actions?: readonly CollectionMutationAction[];
}
/** Records serviced-collection messages and owns its hub subscription. */
declare class CollectionChangeRecorder<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: CollectionChangeFilter);
    get records(): readonly CollectionChangedMessage<T>[];
    get actions(): readonly CollectionMutationAction[];

    dispose(): void;
}
declare function recordCollectionChanges<T>(hub: IMessageHub, filter?: CollectionChangeFilter): CollectionChangeRecorder<T>;
type ObservableListMutationAction = CollectionMutationAction;
interface ObservableListChange<T> {
    readonly action: ObservableListMutationAction;
    readonly newItems: readonly T[];
    readonly oldItems: readonly T[];
    readonly newIndex: number;
    readonly oldIndex: number;
}
/** Records ObservableList's granular streams as one semantic ordered history. */

    #private;
    constructor(list: ObservableList<T>);
    get records(): readonly ObservableListChange<T>[];
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function recordObservableList<T>(list: ObservableList<T>): ObservableListRecorder<T>;

interface CommandDoubleOptions {
    readonly canExecute?: boolean;
}
/** Runner-neutral controllable double for a parameterless command. */
declare class CommandDouble implements ICommand {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: CommandDoubleOptions);
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    get executionCount(): number;
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    setCanExecute(value: boolean): void;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    failWith(error: Error | null): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
/** Runner-neutral controllable double for a parameterized command. */
declare class CommandDoubleOf<T> implements ICommandOf<T> {
    #private;
    constructor(options?: CommandDoubleOptions);
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    get executions(): readonly T[];
    canExecute(_parameter: T): boolean;
    execute(parameter: T): void;
    setCanExecute(value: boolean): void;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    failWith(error: Error | null): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
/** A manually completed, cancellable IAsyncCommand test double. */
declare class AsyncCommandDouble implements IAsyncCommand {
    #private;
    get canExecuteChanged(): Observable<void>;
    get errors(): Observable<unknown>;
    get executionCount(): number;
    get isExecuting(): boolean;
    canExecute(): boolean;
    execute(): void;
    executeAsync(externalSignal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;
    setCanExecute(value: boolean): void;
    raiseCanExecuteChanged(): void;
    resolve(): void;
    reject(error: unknown): void;
    cancel(): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}

type FormHarnessOptions<T> = Omit<FormVMOptions<T>, "persister" | "hub">;
/**
 * Test harness around the real FormVM lifecycle with a controllable persister.
 */
declare class FormHarness<T> {
    #private;
    readonly hub: RecordingMessageHub;
    readonly form: FormVM<T>;
    readonly propertyChanges: PropertyChangeRecorder<FormVM<T>>;
    constructor(options: FormHarnessOptions<T>);
    get persistAttempts(): readonly T[];
    get approved(): readonly T[];
    get approveErrors(): readonly unknown[];
    set(value: T): void;
    approve(): Promise<void>;
    deny(): void;
    failNext(error: Error): void;
    clear(): void;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function createFormHarness<T>(options: FormHarnessOptions<T>): FormHarness<T>;

export { AsyncCommandDouble, type CollectionChangeFilter, CollectionChangeRecorder, CommandDouble, CommandDoubleOf, type CommandDoubleOptions, FormHarness, type FormHarnessOptions, ManualDispatcher, type ObservableListChange, type ObservableListMutationAction, ObservableListRecorder, type PropertyChangeFilter, PropertyChangeRecorder, RecordingMessageHub, type TestServices, createFormHarness, createTestServices, recordCollectionChanges, recordObservableList, recordPropertyChanges };
